findings.description: Retrieval: downloaded the faculty (https://eng.auburn.edu/ece/people/), emeritus and joint lists at 2026-11-25T02:23:58-59Z, after brief.created_at 2026-11-25T02:22:15Z; hashes are of the downloaded bytes. Parsed 34 + 20 + 4 = 58 person entries; every entry matched exactly one brief person by name and directory ID; no omissions in either direction. Coverage complete.

Profiles fetched over https for Kirkici, Lall, Katz and Robinson. The Jin profile (https://eng.auburn.edu/directory/wzj0029) returned 404 on https and http; his decision rests on the joint list entry. This is an info note, not a source failure.

Faculty list: 30 professorial/affiliated entries included (29 regular, 1 affiliate_professor); 4 excluded (2 Senior Lecturers as teaching, 2 Visiting professors as visiting). Emeritus list: all 20 excluded as emeritus, past. Joint list: 3 included as joint_secondary, 1 excluded. Totals: 33 included (all current, no incoming appointments stated), 25 excluded, 0 unresolved.

Hulya Kirkici included as affiliate_professor. Department faculty list and her profile both state 'Affiliate Professor' in Electrical and Computer Engineering, a department-designated professorial affiliation. Would change to excluded only if the department designation were shown to be non-professorial.

Pradeep Lall excluded. The joint list places him under the 'Courtesy Joint Faculty' heading, but his title on that page and his official profile give Mechanical Engineering as the department and state no ECE joint, courtesy or affiliate appointment. The specific profile outranks the generic heading. Would change to joint_secondary (included) only if an official source states an ECE joint or courtesy professorial appointment.

Jennifer Robinson included as joint_secondary: 'Associate Professor of Psychology' with 'Joint Appointment in Electrical and Computer Engineering' on the joint list and her profile. Subtype (regular vs courtesy) not stated.

Jeffrey S Katz included as joint_secondary: 'Professor of Psychology' with 'Joint Appointment in Electrical and Computer Engineering' on the joint list and his profile. Subtype (regular vs courtesy) not stated.

Wencan Jin included as joint_secondary: 'Assistant Professor of Physics' with 'Joint Appointment in Electrical and Computer Engineering' on the joint list. Profile returned 404, so the list entry is the only evidence; subtype not stated.
